I realize that all the indications I have given you so far are extremely sketshy, and as a consequence that I am charging you with a considerable amount of work to put some sense and order into all that. Thus it is I, not you, who should apologize for causing a lot of trouble! I look forward with great pl\unsure{a|e}\unsure{d|a}sure meeting you in Bures. As I am having some russian andchinese lessons on fridays, I will probably drop by on June 2.

With best regards\\

notes: Closing page of a typed letter: seven body lines and the separate closing With best regards. The writer calls his earlier indications “extremely sketshy” and says they require work “to put some sense and order into all that”; this is a general qualification, not a reservation attached to a named theorem. He anticipates meeting the recipient in Bures, mentions russian andchinese lessons on fridays, and proposes June 2 for a visit. No year, dateline, title, total page count or readable signature is present. The archive number 38 is retained as a comment. No mathematical claim is developed or checked on this page. The word after great has eight cells; two middle cells are mixed, so the unsupported nine-cell pleadsure is removed while the visible a/e and d/a alternatives remain explicit. The small brown mark below the closing is drawn with a filled body and darker curves; whether it is deliberate or incidental, and its maker/material, remain unresolved. C’s gray open-curve approximation is revised to the observed color and mass. H omits this figure and inserts a word space in andchinese and a punctuation gap before !. The Finitude section heading at the end of the extracted H excerpt is editorial/batch-boundary material, not an ink reading for this sheet, so it is excluded from the collation count. H’s page number 38 and the archive comment are semantically equivalent; the missing page macro in the excerpt is not an omission. No OCR, external research, mathematical verification or LaTeX compilation was used.
slips: extremely sketshy; russian; andchinese; fridays. The overtyped word remains uncertain rather than silently repaired to pleasure.
adjudication: All three finished readings and inventories compared. Four substantive difference clusters inspected using two existing reader crops and two new main crops.
